Prerequisites: An opponent is about to lose the game due to lethal infect and/or commander damage.
Steps: When an opponent is about to lose the game due to lethal infect and/or commander damage, before damage is dealt, activate Zedruu by paying {R}{W}{U}, giving the opponent about to lose the game control of Lich's Mirror.

  This creates a mandatory infinite loop, which ends the game in a draw.
